entities.summary: The Academy of Music is a Croatian music school based in Zagreb. It is one of the three art academies affiliated with the University of Zagreb, along with the Academy of Dramatic Art and the Academy of Fine Arts. Music Academy, Zagreb is a faculty in Europe, established in 1829. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
